instructor: I love Michelle Hoca. She is sweet, respectful and nice to listen. She has no strict rules at all. She is knowledgeable in her area for sure, but she seems out of date at times in PSYC101 or has little knowledge in some areas as she has stated: "I don't know about psychoanalysis." It is acceptable that she might have specialized in neuroscience and does not know much about other areas. But in my opinion it is better to have a decent amount of knowledge from nearly all areas of psychology to be well equipped in the area, especially psychoanalysis which is the historical starting point of scientific psychology. She has regarded Freud's theories as nonsense and skipped them quickly throughout the lessons despite their wide appliances throughout therapies and understanding psychology. Also, I have seen a few out-of-date things in her slides of PSYC101. DSM-IV was out of use in 2013 and has many aspects which are considered nonsense and useless nowadays. We learn about these aspects instead of DSM-V in the lessons and we learn out of date psychology glossary alongside DSM-IV. And the only book we never use besides smartbook assignments has DSM-V in it instead of IV. Her slides seems to have been created before 2013 and psychology is a fastly developing area unlike many sciences. Psychology requires to be up-to-date at all times.
